title: User – response
description: POST /users (201), GET and PATCH /users/{id}, PUT /users/{id}/pin, POST /sites/{id}/users (200). The user as sync pull delivers it to the caller: site_ids limited to the caller's sites, the PIN fields only to the site phone. Error responses use api/error.json.

pin.description: Only when the server generated the PIN: the only time it is shown. Tell it to the user.
